text: 天数智芯公告，预计截至2026年6月30日止六个月净利润约人民币6000万元至人民币1.4亿元，上年同期净亏损约人民币6.09亿元。业绩扭亏为盈主要归因于报告期内按公允价值计入损益的金融资产的公允价值收益介乎约人民币7.3亿元至人民币7.9亿元。
text_en: Tianshu Zhixin announced that it expects a net profit of approximately RMB 60 million to RMB 140 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with a net loss of approximately RMB 609 million in the same period last year. The turnaround to profitability is mainly attributed to fair value gains on financial assets measured at fair value through profit or loss, ranging from approximately RMB 730 million to RMB 790 million during the reporting period.
